permissions.read: explicit input files and configured model/embedding files
permissions.write: configured job/cache directories and explicit package destination
permissions.network: configured embedding endpoint and model-author downloads when enabled

hostResponsibilities: Provide the trusted interpreter and install pinned dependencies
Collect file selection and mapping confirmation before remote embedding
Show remote-data destination and obtain the application's required consent
Store credentials with the host secret store; inject them only into the worker
Render artifact paths only inside the returned run directory
Treat run_prepared as partial and run_completed/result.json as final
Handle cancellation and unexpected exits; recover a stale lock explicitly
